```{r}
ui <- fluidPage(
    theme=shinythemes::shinytheme("united"),
  dashboardPage(
    
  
  dashboardHeader(title = "Countries Throughout The Years"),
 
  dashboardSidebar(title = "Variables",
  
  
  selectInput("filter",
              "select country",
             choices = unique(gapminder$name),
    
 selected = "USA"),
  
  selectInput("y",
              "Select Year Variable",
              choices = c("life_expectancy",
                          "Co2_emissions",
                          "population"),
           selected = "population")), 
    dashboardBody(
   
  plotOutput("plot", width="900px", height= "800px"))
  
))

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    
  gapminder %>% 
      filter(name== input$filter) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=.data[[input$y]], na.rm=T))+
scale_y_log10()+
  geom_line(aes(color= "aquamarine"))+
  geom_point(na.rm=T, shape=1, color= "blue")+
  scale_x_continuous()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=60, hjust=1))+
  labs(
       x="Year",
       legend=NULL)+
      theme_minimal()
    
    gapminder %>% 
 filter(name=="USA") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=.data[[input$y]]))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point(shape=1)+
  scale_x_continuous()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=60, hjust=1))+
  labs(title=,
       x="")
      theme_minimal()
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

```{r}
 gapminder %>% 
 filter((year>=2000 & year<=2025) & name=="USA") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=year, y=population))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point(shape=5)+
  scale_x_continuous()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=60, hjust=1))+
  labs(title="GDP per Capita in the USA, 2000-2025",
       x="Year",)
      theme_minimal()
```
